decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter tied to the firm's core track-system offer, it likely has low carrying cost and strong ecosystem value, so keeping this option is more attractive than pruning it.

This LED luminaire line sits close to the core business and benefits from favorable industry demand, but as a multi-model line it could still face some portfolio rationalization if newer designs crowd it out.

The home automation server box is more technologically demanding and less central than luminaires, so after several years the uncertainty is likely more resolved and its support costs make redeploying resources more attractive.

A luminaire family is squarely within the firm's established premium lighting range, and unless sales have clearly disappointed, the option value of retaining a proven core-category line should still exceed its carrying cost.
